rubrics.baseline_defect: TextDrawer uses RenderSurface requiring geometry and protocols.
rubrics.criterion: Make text rendering available through only the capabilities actually used, without the universal RenderSurface obligation.
rubrics.acceptance: Keep zero-width prefix silent, initial prefix repeats, wrapped prefix obeys repeat flag else fills width/font_size spaces with optional background first. Styled chunks restore colors only nondefault style; prefix does not inherit that restoration. Padding saturates line remainder then adds right padding, emits no commands if zero. Same focused text capability may include these coherent policies. Existing narrow TerminalIo, ScaleImage and PrintImage implementations remain valid. Cohesive helpers/free functions or narrower traits qualify; no prescribed trait count or name. Equivalent functions, policy data, composition or a redesigned flow qualify; no prescribed helper, class, file, return object or one-component-per-item design is required. One coherent redesign may satisfy multiple independent items.
insufficient_repairs: Renaming RenderSurface or wrapping a dummy scaler while retaining the broad internal bound is insufficient; unchanged external narrow entry points alone do not repair internal coupling.
